metadata.name: oidc-client-set-backchannel-logout-uri
metadata.description: Apply the RFC 8417 backchannel_logout_uri on an existing oidc_clients row. Targets yggdrasil-core's own Postgres via integration-database-admin; the operator passes the admin DSN per-call so no hardcoded coupling to a specific cluster's secret store survives.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: HTTPS endpoint where yggdrasil-core POSTs the signed logout_token. RFC 8417 §2.5. Example: 'https://tartaro.dakasa.me/tartaro/oidc/back-channel-logout'.

admin_dsn.description: Privileged Postgres DSN for the yggdrasil-core database. Should be resolved from the operator's secret store before invocation (e.g. dsn_ref in the workflow_run inputs).

tenant.description: AdminTarget tenant label (audit context, NOT a Postgres role). Example: 'yggdrasil-core-prod'.

actor.description: Caller identity stamped onto the SET LOCAL app.actor inside the txn for trigger-level audit.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the change (logged into SET LOCAL app.reason). Example: 'register tartaro back-channel logout receiver 2026-05-27'.

steps.description: Single parameterized UPDATE wrapped in a transaction with app.actor/app.reason SET LOCAL so DB triggers see the change context.

with.sql: UPDATE public.oidc_clients SET backchannel_logout_uri = $1 WHERE client_id = $2
